_about: The improvement loop (evals/improve.py, docs/improvement-loop.md). Proposals are written from failures on the tuning benchmarks only. The held-out benchmarks are never read while writing a change: they only check that a kept change didn't make the kit worse elsewhere. Each kind of target is on both sides. web-hostile is held out so that no change is tuned to its planted instructions. smoke is a wiring check, in neither. 2026-11-17: code-node moved from held_out to tuning. Its runs were read in detail while fixing the harness (15 to 17 November 2026) and proposal P-003 was written from one, so it can no longer show a change's effect on failures nobody read. laravel-ledgerly (source and a running build) is the held-out code benchmark.
